entries.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create an ORIGINAL production character design sheet for Kael, an aggressive male blade dancer in a premium mobile 2D idle RPG. This is a complete redesign, not the earlier friendly blue knight. Hand-painted anime fantasy cel illustration with elegant strong ink outlines, clean readable color shapes, high-end character design, compact athletic adult at about 3.4 heads tall, expressive narrow amber eyes, sharp young adult face, tousled ivory-white hair with dark undercut at nape, no beard. Outfit: asymmetric charcoal black short battle coat with two long split tapered coattails, exposed flexible waist/legs, one ivory angular shoulder armor, thin deep-crimson lining and crimson fabric sash at the waist (NOT a red neck scarf), black fitted trousers, dark leather shin boots with ivory toe/edge accents, wrapped forearms, one dark fingerless gauntlet holding a distinctive LONG single-edged sword. Sword: slender but clear broad profile, smoky silver blade with ivory cutting edge, dark hilt and angular crimson crescent-shaped guard, no giant gold star. Strong repeated hooked broken-diagonal shapes in coat, guard, armor. The silhouette should look dangerous, agile, stylish and instantly recognizable at 132 pixels; avoid round baby face and generic armor. Show TWO separated full-body character turnarounds side by side on a TRANSPARENT RGBA background: left is three-quarter FRONT facing RIGHT, grounded relaxed fighting guard with blade held down-forward to the right, feet on same baseline, face legible. Right is three-quarter BACK looking right, same proportions and outfit, clear rear hair, back coat and belt construction, sword visible. Same exact man/equipment both views. No text, no labels, no borders, no decorative background, no circles, no shadows baked beneath feet, no glow or particles, no effects. Every extremity, hair and whole sword completely in frame with safe spacing. This is an editable design reference, not a game screenshot. Aim beautiful mature stylized compact anime fantasy art, not pixel art, not 3D.

Use case: identity-preserve. EDIT this Kael character turnaround design. Keep the exact distinctive face, ivory white hair, black/ivory/crimson outfit, crimson crescent sword guard, long sword and front/back costume details. Critical correction: turn BOTH figures into compact stylized adult anime mobile RPG sprites at about 3.5 HEAD HEIGHTS TOTAL, approximately twice as large head relative to body as now. Much shorter compact torso and legs, oversized expressive adult anime head with narrow eyes, still athletic agile and dangerous, NOT realistic 7-head human proportions, NOT cute baby. Think premium hand-painted compact fantasy idle hero: large confident face, clear broad simple color masses, firm bold outline, less tiny buckles/texture. Preserve front threequarter right view and back threequarter right view side by side, full swords completely in frame, no overlapping figures. Isolate both on actual TRANSPARENT RGBA background; absolutely no black/gray/white background, vignette, cast shadow, glow or checkerboard painted into pixels. Grounded feet baseline. No text. This becomes the final source design for a 132px-high animated game character, so silhouette and adult face must read immediately.

Use case: identity-preserve / production 2D rigging sprite parts. Reference is the FINAL original Kael design, preserve exact character appearance, white hair, narrow amber eyes, charcoal asymmetric coat, ivory sharp armor, crimson waist sash and long dark silver single-edged sword with red crescent guard. Create a CLEAN 4-COLUMN BY 5-ROW grid of TWENTY SEPARATED BODY PARTS for a 2D skeletal puppet, portrait canvas. Every cell contains ONE part centered with generous transparent margins. No full assembled characters. No text or grid lines. ACTUAL TRANSPARENT PNG RGBA ALPHA BACKGROUND, not a checkerboard graphic or any opaque background. Draw the complete obscured joint surfaces with overlapping rounded ends; no background shadow or effects. All parts neutral and straight, front threequarter view facing right consistent with left reference figure. Preserve artwork quality, strong smooth outlines, stylized proportions. Required order LEFT TO RIGHT, TOP TO BOTTOM, exactly: row1: (1) head including full white hairstyle and face with short neck nub, NO clothing; (2) sleeveless torso/chest ONLY charcoal coat from neckline to waist, no arms/head/longtails; (3) pelvis waistbelt crimson sash with short upper hip clothing, no legs or longtail; (4) separate raised black coat collar crimson inside. row2: (5) near upper arm with large ivory shoulder armor, shoulder to elbow, vertical; (6) near forearm black ornate gauntlet elbow to wrist vertical; (7) near closed gloved gripping fist alone no sword; (8) complete long sword VERTICAL pointed UP with grip at bottom, exact silver blade and crimson crescent guard. row3: (9) far upper arm simple dark sleeve shoulder to elbow vertical; (10) far forearm wrapped black sleeve elbow to wrist vertical; (11) far open gloved hand alone; (12) small loose white hair tuft secondary motion pointing DOWN. row4: (13) near thigh black trouser hip to knee vertical; (14) near shin lowerleg black shin armor knee to ankle vertical NO foot; (15) near boot foot with ivorytoe pointing RIGHT horizontally, cropped at ankle with full overlap; (16) long separate tapered left coattail black outside crimson lining, narrow attachment at TOP trailing DOWN, no belt. row5: (17) far thigh black trouser hip to knee vertical; (18) far shin armor knee to ankle vertical NO foot; (19) far boot foot ivorytoe pointing RIGHT; (20) shorter separate right coattail charcoal/crimson tapering DOWN, narrow attachment at TOP. Match the same individual's costume throughout. Important: joint ends complete, each piece isolated, no neighboring piece touches or crosses a cell border, no baked checkerboard, no labels. Parts should fill cells comfortably but entirepart remainsinside. Wide head andlong swordcanusemore oftheircell while limbsremainproportional.

Use case: background-extraction. EDIT TARGET is this exact 20-part character rigging sheet. Remove the baked gray-white checkerboard completely and output a PNG with REAL TRANSPARENT RGBA ALPHA at all background pixels, including between parts and inside gaps. This is NOT an illustration request: keep every original painted pixel of the twenty character body parts, the exact layout, sizes, outlines, black coat, white hair/armor and crimson sword/cloth unchanged. Do not redraw the checkerboard or replace it with white/gray/black. The output must have alpha=0 outside all twenty pieces. Do not erase white character pixels or dark armor. No shadows, effects, new parts or text. Preserve exact image dimensions and part placement.

Use case: identity-preserve. Production alternative-view body sprites for the EXACT compact adult anime Kael in reference. Ivory white tousled hair/darknape, sharp amber eyes, charcoal shortcoat, ivory angular shoulder, crimson sash and lining. TWO ROWS of SIX isolated parts (12 parts total), 3:1 landscape canvas. Solid UNIFORM WHITE BACKGROUND for later game import; NO checkerboard, shadows or decorative backdrop. One piece centered in each cell with safe generous margins; do not draw grid or text. TOP ROW is threequarter BACK VIEW facing away and to RIGHT; BOTTOM ROW is RIGHT SIDE PROFILE view (nose pointing right, bodyedge-on). Each row same required order left-to-right: 1 Head complete whitehair/head/necknub NO clothes (rear head MUST show BACK of whitehair and darkundercut, little or no face); 2 sleeveless Torso ONLY from neckline to waist no arms/head/tails (rear shows distinctive ivory V crest on black back); 3 Pelvis crimson waist sash/belt short hipcloth ONLY no legs/tails; 4 separate raised black coat Collar crimson interior; 5 small secondary loose white Hair tuft bending down; 6 near upper Arm with ivory shoulderarmor shoulder-to-elbow vertical. Preserve exact costume identity and identical relative part sizes between both rows. Limb roots and occluded overlap areas fully drawn. These replace the corresponding front sprites during a turning animation: not a second costume, no equipment additions, no full assembled man, no sword, no effect. Smooth dark outlines, clean painted anime shapes, highquality handdrawn sprite components.

Use case: stylized-concept. Original hand-painted VFX TEXTURE ATLAS for an aggressive dark anime blade dancer. Landscape 2:1 canvas, EXACTLY 4 columns by 2 rows, EIGHT equally sized SQUARE cells. Every cell one separate centered effect with abundant EMPTY black margin, nothing touches borders. Pure solid BLACK background (no checkerboard), glow tapering fully into black, no text, lines, frames or figures. Limited deep crimson/red + hot warm IVORY energy, broken brush-like tapered silhouettes, sharp exciting dynamic shapes with textured inner wisps, NOT clean geometric rings/lines. The effect direction primarily LEFT TO RIGHT. Top row left-to-right: 1 long thin hooked brushstroke SLASH curving up slightly, pointed bright tip at right; 2 broader crescent diagonal sweep with tapered ends and jagged dissolving red fringe; 3 compact rising flame of sword energy, narrow ivory core with crimson tongues flowing upward; 4 small asymmetric sharp contact spark burst pointing right, ivory center with only a few dramatic shards. Bottom row: 5 LARGE dramatic finalhit burst, angular ivory core, crimson sharp lobes and black negative gaps, concentrated strong center; 6 fragmented trailing slash dissolving left into few long wisps, bright tip right; 7 small scattered narrow glowing red/ivory shard cluster, no circulardots; 8 separate inky crimson smoky lash/vapor streamer thinandsharp with no ring. Each effect has an artistic irregular hand-painted contour and a distinct design; keep background genuinely uniform black outside glow. Not a screenshot, no UI, no circles, no characters. Production tile atlas readable in 2D game at 100-250pixels.

Use case: identity-preserve. Draw a special ULTIMATE ACTION ILLUSTRATION of this EXACT newly redesigned Kael for his mobile game cinematic, horizontal 2:1 canvas. Same compact stylized adult male face, white tousled hair, amber eyes, charcoal asymmetrical coat with ivory nearshoulder and deepcrimson lining, crescent red swordguard. This is a NEW energetic combat pose, NOT a crop of the standing reference: low forward torso twist, fierce focused eyes, one gloved hand thrusting the long silver blade diagonally toward the right foreground, coat folds whip toward left, expressive foreshortening. Head and chest in LEFT THIRD of canvas, blade extends across middle-right, pointedtipcompletelyinside, rightmost 15percent empty. Frame waist-up, no legs. Clean bold painted anime lines and large ink/crimson/ivory shapes, refined detailedface, graphic tapered energy accents behind blade that don't hide face. No circles, no text, no UI, no border. On uniform pure white background for production compositing; no checkerboard, no drop shadow. Exciting illustration that complements but does not replace the real animated battle sprite.

Use case: identity-preserve. Square mobile RPG COLLECTION PORTRAIT of the exact redesigned Kael in reference. Tight head and upper shoulder composition, white tousled hair with darknape, sharp amber eyes, adultanime face (not baby), slight fierce knowing smirk, charcoal coat highcollar with crimson lining, ivory angular shoulderarmor visible. Face fills most of square andlooks threequarter RIGHT, matching actualcharacter. Confident aggressive blade dancer, beautiful clean hand-painted anime shapes andstrong outline, premium polished production art. Dark charcoal background with subtle deep crimson painted stroke behind his head, no bright noisy effects. Limited ivory/crimson/charcoal palette, legible at60pixels. No text, border, icon, sword across face or watermark. Preserveexactidentity; don'tuseoldblueknight.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create one premium mobile RPG active skill ICON for Kael's Crescent Tempest / Sichelsturm. Square image. Show his distinctive long silver single-edged blade with dark hilt and CRIMSON CRESCENT guard (same as reference), making a fierce ascending hooked slash and dominant descending finishing cut. Mainshapeonepowerfulcrimsoncrescentwithivoryknifeedge, a few sharp painted shard accents, smoky charcoal background. No character face or fullbody, no text, no frames, no numbers, no circles, no logo. Verystrong silhouette andcontrolled contrast readable at48pixels. Polished hand-painted anime fantasy, black/ivory/deepred palette, exciting asymmetrical composition, not a generic yellow glowing sword. Weapon identity consistent reference; one clear sword, not two weapons.
